name: Windkessel Lumped-Parameter Hemodynamic Model
summary: Represent aggregate vascular resistance, compliance and optionally characteristic impedance with a small ODE/circuit model.
core_idea: Approximate distal arterial load with 2- or 3-element lumped pressure–flow relationships.
innovation: Provides physiologically interpretable low-order terminal boundary conditions and parameters for inverse calibration.
limitations: Spatial wave effects are approximated rather than explicitly resolved.
Parameters can be weakly identifiable from limited measurements.

start_here.why: Concise authoritative review comparing variants and physiological meaning.
start_here.focus: 2- versus 3-element Windkessel; parameter interpretation and limits.

curation_note: Core method concept and checked source(s) recorded; suggested readings remain advisory and may be revised.
